# gpu_warp_test's pointer golden (README WA33): the slot after CursorOverlay::Blend of
# the color pointer at upright (10, 20) on a 64x48 panel frame turned 90 degrees clockwise:
# in the slot it lies turned 90 degrees counterclockwise, so it comes out upright,
# over the four-quadrant background (gpu_warp_support.h). Straight alpha; the test allows 1 code value.
size 64 48
palette
e FF103090
a FF202060
c FF206020
f FF7F7FFF
. FFC0C0C0
d FFE01010
b FFFFFFFF
